CONDITION_EDITOR.THIS_CONDITION_HAS_GROU: This condition has groups, so it can't be edited here. Change it through the API or an import. The message and the switch can still be changed, and the condition is kept as it is.
DEFAULT_VALUE_FIELDS.FIELDNAME_IS_STORED: {{fieldName}} is stored only when an insert sends it.
DEFAULT_VALUE_FIELDS.TAKEN_WHEN_EACH_REC: Taken when each record is created
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.APPLIED_ON_INSERT_AN: Applied on insert and bulk insert when the property is missing or null, before required and validation checks.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.FOR_A_RECORD_CREATED: for a record created right now
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.ONE_OF_THE_ALLOWED_V: One of the allowed values. Pick it again to clear.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.PICK_A_FIXED_DATE_UT: Pick a fixed date (UTC), or use Expression to fill in the current date and time when each record is created.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.PICK_TRUE_OR_FALSE_P: Pick true or false. Pick it again to clear.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.STORED_IN_UTC_RECORD: Stored in UTC. Records created together in one bulk insert all get the same date and time.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.THE_DEFAULT_COULD_NO: The default could not be saved.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.TYPE_FIXED_TEXT_ADD_: Type fixed text, add expressions filled at insert time, or mix them. A missing value becomes empty text.
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.TYPE_TEXT_OR_ADD_AN_: Type text, or add an expression
DEFAULT_VALUE_PANEL.UNSAVED_APPLIES_FROM: Unsaved · applies from the next publish
DEFAULT_VALUE_UTIL.EXPRESSIONS_CAN_ONLY_: Expressions can only be used on text properties
DEFAULT_VALUE_UTIL.NOT_ONE_OF_THE_LISTED: "{{value}}" is not one of the listed values ({{values}})
DEFAULT_VALUE_UTIL.NOW_CAN_ONLY_BE_USED_: Now can only be used on single date-time properties
DEFAULT_VALUE_UTIL.THE_DATE_AND_TIME_THE: The date and time the record is created
The date and time the record is created, {{adjustments}}
REFERENCE_TARGET_PICKER.FIELDNAME_IS_NOT: {{fieldName}} is not unique. The check still works, but is faster when this field is indexed.
REFERENCE_TARGET_PICKER.HAS_NO_NUMBER_FI: {{schemaName}} has no number field to match.
REFERENCE_TARGET_PICKER.HAS_NO_TEXT_FIEL: {{schemaName}} has no text field to match.
REFERENCE_TARGET_PICKER.OWNSCHEMANAME_IS: {{ownSchemaName}} isn't offered here. For no duplicates within {{ownSchemaName}}, use the Unique flag on the property.
REFERENCE_TARGET_PICKER.THIS_SCHEMA_USE_: This schema. Use the Unique flag instead
RULE_MESSAGES.AUTH_VALUES_AREN_T_AVAILAB: Auth values aren't available in validation rules: use an access policy
RULE_MESSAGES.A_CONDITION_CAN_T_NAME_A: A condition can't name a property inside a list of objects yet
RULE_MESSAGES.A_CONDITION_MUST_START_WIT: A condition must start with a property of the record
RULE_MESSAGES.A_DATE_RELATIVE_TO_NOW_ONL: A date relative to now only works in greater than, less than and range rules
RULE_MESSAGES.A_FILTER_COMPARES_THE_OTHE: A filter compares the other schema's properties with fixed values only
RULE_MESSAGES.A_FIXED_VALUE_CAN_T_CONTAI: A fixed value can't contain {{…}}: compare with a property instead
RULE_MESSAGES.A_PROPERTY_CAN_T_BE_CHECKE: A property can't be checked against its own schema: mark it as unique instead
RULE_MESSAGES.A_RULE_ON_A_PROPERTY_INSID: A rule on a property inside a list of objects can't have a condition yet
RULE_MESSAGES.A_SINGLE_VALUE_CAN_T_CONTA: A single value can't contain a comma: use "is one of" for a list
RULE_MESSAGES.CHOOSE_THE_SCHEMA_TO_CHECK: Choose the schema to check against
RULE_MESSAGES.CONDITION_ON_LOOKUP: "Exists in" and "must not exist in" rules can't have a condition yet: use a filter on the other schema
RULE_MESSAGES.EACH_GROUP_OF_CONDITIONS_N: Each group of conditions needs at least one condition
RULE_MESSAGES.ENTER_A_VALUE_TO_COMPARE_W: Enter a value to compare with
RULE_MESSAGES.ENTER_A_WHOLE_NUMBER_OF_IT: Enter a whole number of items, 0 or more
RULE_MESSAGES.FIELD_COMPARISON_KIND: {{left}} and {{right}} hold different kinds of value and can't be compared
RULE_MESSAGES.INVALID_NOW: "{{value}}" isn't a date relative to now: write {{Now}}, {{Now-18y}} or {{Now+30d}} (units y, mo, d, h, min)
RULE_MESSAGES.IS_ONE_OF_IS_NOT_ONE: Is one of / is not one of takes at most 500 values
RULE_MESSAGES.IS_ONE_OF_IS_NOT_ONE_2: Is one of / is not one of needs a list of values
RULE_MESSAGES.IS_ONE_OF_IS_NOT_ONE_3: Is one of / is not one of needs at least one value
RULE_MESSAGES.ITEMID_CAN_T_BE_COMPARED_W: ItemId can't be compared with another property
RULE_MESSAGES.NOW_ONLY_FOR_DATES: A date relative to now only works on a date-time property
RULE_MESSAGES.NO_DUPLICATES_WORKS_ON_A_L: No duplicates works on a list of values, not a list of objects
RULE_MESSAGES.ONLY_EXISTS_IN_AND_MUST_NO: Only "exists in" and "must not exist in" rules take a filter
RULE_MESSAGES.THIS_RULE_CAN_T_BE_USED: This rule can't be used on a system schema: system schemas take only the older rule types, with no condition, filter or date relative to now
RULE_MESSAGES.THIS_RULE_CHECKS_A_LIST_SO: This rule checks a list, so it only works on a list property
RULE_MESSAGES.TWO_PROPERTIES_CAN_ONLY_BE: Two properties can only be compared with equals, is not, greater than or less than
RULE_MESSAGES.UNKNOWN_PROPERTY: {{name}} isn't a property of this schema
RULE_MESSAGES.VALUES_NOT_FOR_TYPE: Is one of / is not one of can't be used on a {{kind}} property
RULE_STATIC_VALUE.CHOOSE_ONE_OF_THE_PROP: Choose one of the property's values
RULE_STATIC_VALUE.ENTER_WHOLE_NUMBERS_SE: Enter whole numbers separated by commas
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.A_SAVE_WITHOUT_SHORTFI: A save without {{shortField}} isn't counted. Mark {{shortField}} as required to make sure it is sent.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.DELETED_TARGETNAME_REC: Deleted {{targetName}} records stop counting once the rule is saved.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.EXACT_MATCH_APPROVED_I: Exact match: approved is not Approved.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.FAILS_WHEN_THE_LIST_HO: Fails when the list holds the same value twice (exact match).
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.FAILS_WHEN_THE_VALUE_I: Fails when the value is missing or blank (an empty list, for a list).
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.INSERTS_AND_UPDATES_AR: Inserts and updates are refused when the value (each item, for a list) is found there. Checked when the record is saved: if a {{targetName}} with the same {{ownFieldName}} is created at the same moment, both saves can get through.
Inserts and updates are refused when the value (each item, for a list) is not found there. Empty values are not checked.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.NOW_OR_AN_AMOUNT_BEFOR: now, or an amount before or after it
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.PASTE_A_COMMA_SEPARATE: Paste a comma-separated list to add several.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.SAVED_TODAY_BOUND_MOVE: Saved today, {{sentence}}. The bound moves with each save. Times are UTC.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.STALE_VALUES_NO_LONGER: {{values}} is no longer a value of {{field}}: switch it off to save.
{{values}} are no longer a value of {{field}}: switch them off to save.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.THE_ENUM_S_OWN_VALUES_: The enum's own values, picked as toggles.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.THIS_RULE_WAS_SAVED_BE: This rule was saved before deleted records were left out, so a deleted {{targetName}} still counts as existing. With the new behaviour, deleted {{targetName}} records stop counting.
RULE_VALUE_INPUTS.WITH_A_CONDITION_IT_FA: With a condition, it fails even when {{shortField}} isn't sent.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.ACTIVE_ENF: Active — enforced on insert and update
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.ACTIVE_SWI: Active — switch off to keep the validation without enforcing it
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.CONDITIONS: Conditions read this record's own values: a fixed value, or another property of the same record. Text values are shown in quotes, property names without. To depend on who is saving, use an access policy.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.DELETE_THI: Delete this validation? Records already stored are not re-checked.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.DESCRIBE_W: Describe what the value should look like
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.E_G_GENERA: e.g. Generate a regex pattern to validate email addresses
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.FIELDNAME_: {{fieldName}} accepts any value of its type.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.INACTIVE_S: Inactive — switch on to enforce it
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.LEFT_EMPTY: Left empty, the message names the date the value was checked against.
Left empty, the message names the value listed twice.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.SAVING_SWI: Saving switches this rule from the list as a whole to each item of the list.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.THE_PATTER: The pattern is written for you; check it before saving.
SCHEMA_FIELD_VALIDATION_PANEL.WRITTEN_FR: Written from the validation. Change it if you like.

VALIDATION_CONDITIONS.ENTER_ONE_OR_MORE_: Enter one or more values, separated by commas
VALIDATION_CONDITIONS.PICK_THE_PROPERTY_: Pick the property to compare with
VALIDATION_RULES_UTIL.CHOOSE_THE_SCHEMA_: Choose the schema the value must exist in
VALIDATION_RULES_UTIL.ENTER_A_WHOLE_NUMB: Enter a whole number of 0 or more
VALIDATION_RULES_UTIL.ENTER_WHOLE_NUMBER: Enter whole numbers of 0 or more
VALIDATION_RULES_UTIL.FIELD_IS_NOT_IN_TH: {{field}} is not in the right format
